name: productivity-pwa
description: PWA COMPLETO COM BACKEND E TESTES

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../..
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/data test-results playwright-report .lighthouseci
